source_units: metres, site-local +Y north/+X east; object elevation relative to building terrain baseline
source_identity: Use site/building/plan/floor/unit/area and source row identity. apartment_id is only site-unique; a repeated bare ID is not physical project identity.
split_prerequisite: Keep all current sites quarantined. Review FAMILY proposals and unresolved coverage; fix any development selection and all linked sites before deriving scenes or views. No sealed split is automatically created.

native_capabilities_observed.fact: RoomGeometry holds arbitrary wall SceneObject list, optional floor object and SDF tree; dimensions also present.
PlacedRoom documentation assumes four cardinal walls and rectangular width/depth; RoomSpec is rectangular metadata.
_check_floor_bounds tests only object center against [-length/2,length/2] x [-width/2,width/2]; it does not inspect a source floor polygon or furniture footprint.
Existing summary enumerates actual wall IDs/bounds and openings; it does not infer enclosure, but does not expose a floor polygon.

mapping_requirements.destination: Immutable native floor geometry plus exact source area partition metadata
mapping_requirements.required_checks: Preserve holes, disconnected pieces and area boundaries. Round-trip projected union/area/coordinates against original source; do not replace geometry by a rectangle. Declare elevation and default-height provenance.

mapping_requirements.destination: Immutable source-bound wall/column/railing meshes and SDF references
mapping_requirements.required_checks: Retain polygon footprint, source elevation/height and type. Do not infer missing construction details or treat railing as full-height wall.

mapping_requirements.destination: Source-bound door/window/opening geometry and explicit clearance metadata
mapping_requirements.required_checks: Preserve placement, width, height and elevation; clip wall volumes correctly. Door swing, handing and actuation remain unknown unless sourced; axis-aligned enums must not silently rotate slanted openings.

mapping_requirements.destination: Named source-bound fixed feature or explicitly marked visual proxy
mapping_requirements.required_checks: Keep asset/category correspondence and dimensions distinct. A sink or kitchen footprint is not evidence of plumbing, operability or capacity.
Keep source north/east and original scale. Geometry-fingerprint rotation/mirroring is for grouping only and must never overwrite scene orientation.

mapping_requirements.destination: Original request=null when absent; researcher-authored assumptions and activities listed separately
mapping_requirements.required_checks: Do not call synthesized occupant requirements source facts. No designer after-the-fact explanation or solution coordinates in runtime demand card.

before_model_inference: Validate full object footprint containment against allowed floor polygons and holes; rectangular center-point acceptance is insufficient.
Validate source wall/opening geometry, immutable identities and truthful summary; preserve unsupported constructs as unknown or refuse import.
Verify actual native serialization/cold restore and five-view visibility for slanted/concave walls; previous rectangular render checks do not cover these shapes.
Freeze a fresh finite run and input versions; do not reuse completed Geneva/Paris budgets.
